items.html: And through this you will understand what is said in Idra de Haazinu, page 293a, concerning the forehead of ZA, and this is its language: "When this forehead is revealed, the masters of judgments are aroused," etc. And we have established that the forehead is called Netzah, with the letters conjoined. The matter is that since the two lower segments of Netzah and Hod of Atik Yomin are in the aspect of a soul for the Daat of ZA, therefore the aspect of the judgments is aroused there, in his forehead, which is opposite the place of Daat; for all aspects of Netzah and Hod, wherever they are, are judgments. Thus it is found that Netzah is revealed in the forehead.
